verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents migration from another provider or a spreadsheet through white-glove onboarding, a Spreadsheet Import feature, and platform-specific guides for Pulley and Carta. So the core migration path exists, but the evidence is thin and much of it is help-article titles. Missing for 10: documented validation of imported data, reconciliation against source documents, detail on a guided self-serve import flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of migration quality.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate an existing cap table — from a spreadsheet or another platform — with guided import, validation, and reconciliation against source documents

citations.quote: Let us migrate your cap table from another provider or spreadsheet to Eqvista, and enjoy fast, white-glove onboarding with the support of our dedicated team.
